what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Vietnam in Japan: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2017, the last year with a figure, UNHCR counted 2490 Vietnamese asylum seekers in Japan, 35.0% of all asylum seekers from Vietnam.
Refugees from Vietnam, a separate group, live mostly in France, the United Kingdom, Germany and Thailand.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Vietnam, so it does not say why people left.
The main year of displacement in the data is 2017.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group runs from 2008, at 6 asylum seekers, to 2017.
Its highest and last figure is for 2017.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Japan.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Japan only; the data has no figure after 2017.
